name: chrono-trigger
notes: Chrono Trigger (SNES) look: taller, less-chibi proportions built on a stick-figure skeleton with a smaller head-to-body ratio than Pokemon (more room for costuming and limb posing). Native frame 32x48; the average human is ~32px tall. ~12 colours per sprite (under the SNES 16-colour cap). Colored line work, NOT pure black: the outline is a darker shade of each material it borders (e.g. dark red/brown for hair, costume-specific darks elsewhere), which makes the sprite read as rich and vibrant. ~2-3 values per material (skin uses base+shade; hair often steps 3-4 colours). Occasional bright white highlights on reflective or attention-worthy bits (gloves, boots, metal, and the odd skin dot at shoulder/knee). Spiky dramatic hair assembled from a mosaic of triangle shapes is the dominant silhouette feature; prominent cuffs and small details (wristbands, straps, belts) are worth keeping even at 2-3px. A soft drop-shadow ellipse sits under the feet. right-facing frames are the horizontal mirror of left-facing.
